title: Call Confirmation - GenStone
text:
Your Scheduled Call is Confirmed
Thank You for Requesting a Call

We have scheduled a call with your Project Coordinator, you should receive an email confirmation soon with the day and time to expect a call.

In the meantime, be sure to have your measurements ready and don’t miss the call, this is a very busy time of year for our team. All calls are scheduled and made on a first come first serve basis.
